# Restaurant Honolulu
> Visitor-first guide to restaurants in Honolulu, Waikīkī and Oʻahu: a filterable directory with hours, prices, happy hours, awards and closures, generated from verified data.

- Directory: https://restauranthonolulu.com/restaurants/
- Search index (JSON): https://restauranthonolulu.com/search-index.json
- Closures tracker: https://restauranthonolulu.com/closed/
- New openings: https://restauranthonolulu.com/new-openings/
- Hale ʻAina Awards: https://restauranthonolulu.com/hale-aina-awards/
- Publisher: Eye To Ad Media (https://www.eyetoad.com)
- Advertising: https://restauranthonolulu.com/advertise/ · 1-800-481-8638 (owners only)
